records.question: How much does the Pro plan cost?
records.answer: The Pro plan costs $49 per month per project [pricing]. Annual billing gives a 15% discount, and registered non-profits receive a 30% discount on Pro [pricing].

records.question: What resources are included in the Starter plan?
records.answer: The Starter plan includes 2 vCPUs, 4 GB of RAM and 20 GB of block storage [pricing]. It costs $0 per month, and projects are limited to one team member with community support only [pricing].

records.question: What is the starting price of the Enterprise plan?
records.answer: I don't know based on the Acme Cloud documentation.

records.question: What discount do non-profits get on Pro?
records.answer: Registered non-profits receive a 30% discount on the Pro plan. [pricing]

records.question: How much do I save by paying annually for Pro?
records.answer: Annual billing on the Pro plan gives a 15% discount [pricing]. Since Pro costs $49 per month per project, that works out to about $7.35 saved per month per project, or roughly $88.20 per year [pricing].

records.question: What uptime does the Enterprise plan commit to?
records.answer: The Enterprise plan has a monthly uptime commitment of 99.99%. [sla]

records.question: What service credit do I get if uptime drops below 99.0%?
records.answer: If monthly uptime falls below 99.0%, you receive a 25% credit of the monthly fee [sla]. You must request it within 30 days of the end of the affected month by opening a ticket with the subject "SLA credit" [sla]. Credits are applied to future invoices and are never paid out as cash [sla].

records.question: How long do I have to request an SLA credit?
records.answer: You must request an SLA credit within 30 days of the end of the affected month. [sla] To do so, open a ticket with the subject "SLA credit". [sla]

records.question: Are SLA credits paid out as cash?
records.answer: No, SLA credits are never paid out as cash. [sla] They are applied to future invoices instead. [sla]

records.question: How is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
records.answer: Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3 [security]. Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days [security]. Enterprise customers can bring their own keys through the Key Vault add-on [security].

records.question: How often are encryption keys rotated?
records.answer: Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days. [security]

records.question: Which plan includes SAML single sign-on?
records.answer: SAML 2.0 single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan only. [security]

records.question: Within how many days can I get a full refund on a new Pro subscription?
records.answer: You can get a full refund on a new Pro subscription within 14 days of the first payment [refunds]. After 14 days, monthly payments are non-refundable [refunds].

records.question: How long does it take for an approved refund to arrive?
records.answer: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days [refunds]. Enterprise contracts instead follow the refund terms in the signed order form [refunds].

records.question: How much free credit do new accounts receive and when does it expire?
records.answer: Every new account receives a $100 free credit [onboarding]. It expires 60 days after sign-up [onboarding].

records.question: How do I install the Acme CLI?
records.answer: Install the Acme CLI with `pip install acme-cli`, which requires Python 3.9 or newer [onboarding]. After installing, authenticate with `acme login`, which opens a browser window [onboarding].

records.question: What is the API rate limit on the Pro plan?
records.answer: The Pro plan allows 600 requests per minute, applied per API key [api-limits].

records.question: What HTTP status code is returned when I exceed the rate limit?
records.answer: Requests that exceed the rate limit receive HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests, along with a `Retry-After` header giving the wait time in seconds [api-limits]. Clients should retry with exponential backoff [api-limits].

records.question: What is the maximum API request body size?
records.answer: The maximum request body size is 10 MB. [api-limits]

records.question: Which payment methods does Acme Cloud accept?
records.answer: Acme Cloud accepts Visa, Mastercard and American Express. [billing] Enterprise customers can also pay by bank transfer with net-30 terms. [billing] PayPal and cryptocurrency are not accepted. [billing]

records.question: What happens if my payment fails?
records.answer: Acme Cloud retries the failed charge 3 times over 7 days [billing]. If the balance is still unpaid after 14 days, the account is suspended until the balance is paid [billing].

records.question: What is the first response time for Pro email support?
records.answer: Pro customers get email support with a first response time of 1 business day [support]. Business-day support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 UTC [support].

records.question: How long are backups kept on the Enterprise plan?
records.answer: Automated backups on the Enterprise plan are retained for 35 days. [data-retention]

records.question: How long after deleting my account is my data erased?
records.answer: Customer data is permanently erased within 30 days of account deletion [data-retention]. Backups containing the data expire according to the normal backup retention schedule [data-retention].

records.question: Which regions does Acme Cloud run in?
records.answer: Acme Cloud runs in four regions: us-east (Virginia), us-west (Oregon), eu-central (Frankfurt) and ap-south (Mumbai). [regions]

records.question: Can I change a project's region after creating it?
records.answer: No, a project's region cannot be changed after creation [regions]. To move, create a new project in the target region and migrate your data [regions].

records.question: Is Acme Cloud HIPAA eligible?
records.answer: Yes, Acme Cloud is HIPAA eligible, but only on the Enterprise plan and after you sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). [compliance]

records.question: What can an Admin do that a Viewer cannot?
records.answer: Admins can deploy and manage resources, whereas Viewers have only read-only access. [teams] Neither role can manage billing, since that is reserved for Owners. [teams]

records.question: How often does Acme post updates during an active incident?
records.answer: Acme Cloud posts an update on the status page at least every 30 minutes during an active incident. [status-incidents]

records.question: How much does object storage egress cost?
records.answer: Egress costs $0.05 per GB after the first 100 GB each month [storage]. The first 100 GB each month is free [storage].
